title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode7 Ideas Given Form

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You, on the drums... Nakanishi. You rushed ahead a bit just now. You need to stay in tempo.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: On the other hand, Sugawara on the sax. You're falling behind a little.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, let's try that again from the top.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. She's playing with a slightly different type of band compared to normal, one which includes saxophones and trumpets...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But she's doing an incredible job, like I thought she would.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, the rhythm section is playing more in sync now. And the wind instruments are sounding good.)

rows.Speaker: Nakanishi
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
Did I rush ahead again?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you stayed in rhythm just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we're still sorta all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I think it has to do with how we each let notes ring and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We all have our own styles, so it'd be nice to pick a lead and stick with them in terms of accentuating, extending or cutting our notes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (A song's feel can change a lot depending on how the notes are handled. But for this one, who can we have...?)

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line:
Pardon me.
I'm here to see how you're all doing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hi. Umm... Is the band coming along, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we're doing better than I expected. But I'm a little lost on how we should play this song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The one where the protagonist sneaks out to go see the town... Can you tell us what sorts of emotions we should be trying to express here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is when she discovers just how much she loves music after meeting the musicians, so it'd be great if you could express how happy and excited she is.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, we should try to add a bit of a spring. Follow Sugawara's lead, shorter sounds with a bit of emphasis.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We'll try playing the prelude.
One, two, three...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Their sound has a nice spring to it...
I can tell how excited Lulu is right now!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we still have room for improvement...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You guys on the trumpets sound a little choppy compared to everyone else. Conversely, guitars, you've got natural sustain, so you need to let go of the strings earlier—

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, you may be right, but do we really have to be that picky about this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I just don't want to cut any corners.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our songwriters put a huge amount of effort into these songs, so I want to give them the respect they deserve.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After all, we only get one chance to play them together like this. If there's anything at all we can do, I want to do it. No regrets.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hope you can understand where I'm coming from here.

rows.Speaker: Band Member
rows.Line:
You're right...
These kinds of opportunities don't come around often, so we should give it our best shot.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm looking forward to their performance during the show.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Me too. I'm sure they're going to sound incredible.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see... We've got our paints, brushes, water and palettes... Yeah, that should be everything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, let's get started, shall we?
I need you all to paint following these lines.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow... She told us that they'd be painting on some big wooden boards, but those are gigantic.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And they're about to turn them into a town.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna make this street yellow! Brushy-brush-brush♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Brush carefully. Stay within the lines...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yeah, I had a feeling she'd be nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's okay. Try to relax.
If you make a mistake, we can always fix it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I don't want to ruin your wonderful drawings...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to get it right the first time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... I decided to go around to see if anyone needed help. I have some time on my hands right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow... This town is gorgeous...
Did you draw all these, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm glad you like what you're seeing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, this is incredible. It's exactly what I envisioned.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've done a wonderful job of capturing the feeling of a town where musicians are able to sing and play whatever songs they like. I can feel freedom and excitement in the air.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If that's what you have in mind, then we may want to take a different approach.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Instead of a blue sky, we might want to make it more colorful. Something like this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We could have musical notes and five-line staves floating in the air like this. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I really like it...!
This makes the town look even more fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm gonna draw some too!
Here's an eighth note with a big smiley face♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. These notes are all smiling. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, Honami...
Why don't you try drawing some?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. We're trying to add an air of freedom, and I think your drawings will do a great job of that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We don't get to draw together like this very often, so I'd like to have as much fun as we can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
I wanna draw lots and lots with you, Honami☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I don't know how my drawings are going to turn out, but I'll try my best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then... I'll try drawing a treble clef here. Umm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
It looks like a really excited puppy!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, in that case...
I'll throw in some effect lines here and...

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Hinomori, Akiyama, I've finished putting in the basting stiches for the protagonist's dress. Can you two tell me what you think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow! These frills are so adorable!
And this lace adds a nice accent! I really like it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I also think it looks wonderful.
The subdued color gives it an air of sophistication. Kusanagi's going to look so good in it.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
You think so? Thank goodness!
I went for a classy design because I knew the director would look awesome in it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I totally forgot! Class A made that film with Kusanagi as the director, right?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yeah! I was also a costume designer for that, but I didn't get to make anything for her that time. So, I'm really glad that I do for this show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, that means I also need to put as much effort as I can into Kusanagi's costume.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Tachibana, I was thinking about embroidering her hair ribbon. Can we talk a little later about what sort of design would be best?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line:
Oh, Kusanagi!
The costumes are coming along really nicely!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They are? That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
Nice timing!
We just finished putting in the basting stitches for your dress, so can you come try it on for us?

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line: Yes, we need to see if it fits properly. Also, I really wanna see you in it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. Actually seeing you in it will help me come up with the right embroidery designs.

rows.Speaker: Tachibana
rows.Line:
So, without further ado...
Let's head to the next classroom over♪

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student
rows.Line: Oh, I'm also done with this suit, so I'd like to see someone try it on.

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student
rows.Line: In terms of the actor's height and build... Akiyama, can you lend me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student
rows.Line:
No, wait...
You don't like wearing these kinds of clothes, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine!
I just really like cute clothes is all. I don't have a problem with cool clothes. Thanks though!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make this suit just as glamorous as the protagonist's dress!
